title: verify_admin_ui_enhancements_functionality
description: Test the custom admin interface improvements to ensure the WordPress backend UI enhancements load correctly, are responsive, and match design specifications.

title: validate_security_hardening_modules
description: Verify that all security modules including honeypot, math captcha, nonce checks, rate limiting, sanitizer, and spam detection effectively prevent common threats without impacting user experience.

title: test_email_notifications_and_smtp_integration
description: Ensure transactional and notification emails are sent and received correctly using SMTP with customizable templates functioning as expected.

title: check_custom_dashboard_widgets_accessibility
description: Validate that custom dashboard widgets and screens are accessible to admin users and function as intended for improved site management.

title: verify_content_ordering_functionality
description: Test the content ordering feature to confirm posts, pages, and custom post types can be reordered correctly.

title: validate_advanced_menu_editor_capabilities
description: Ensure the advanced menu editor allows deeper menu customization and changes are saved and reflected properly.

title: test_spam_protection_mechanisms
description: Verify that spam protection effectively blocks spam on all targeted forms and comment sections using multiple techniques.

title: validate_social_login_integration
description: Test user authentication via all integrated social media platforms to ensure seamless social login functionality.

title: verify_user_role_management_features
description: Check that user roles and capabilities can be created, edited, and assigned properly from the admin panel.

title: test_redirects_management_and_logging
description: Validate that URL redirects can be created, imported/exported, and logged correctly for better site navigation control.
